parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the member account.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on a single page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token for retrieving the next page of results. Omit this parameter for the first request. If a previous response was truncated, pass the `NextToken` value from that response.
